result.description: A fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for color-critical office and studio use, with a matte IPS panel, 2560 x 1440 resolution, 100% sRGB coverage, and integrated USB-C docking. It features tilt, swivel, height adjustment, and low-blue-light presets for long work sessions. The monitor is framed as a general productivity and content-review display rather than a gaming or storage device.
result.title: AeroPulse Meridian 27 Studio Monitor
